note: Both sets cover the same spanwise curves and share the same duplicated points (prebend 0 m and -4 m each stated twice, twist 14/15 deg at r/R=0.0, twist -2 deg at 0.85 twice) and the same weak quotes that cite only axis labels or subplot captions. Set A additionally captures relative thickness 20% at r/R = 1.0, which matches the curve, and a plausible chord point near 5.7 m at r/R = 0.25. remarks: Both sets repeat several facts under identical or near-identical conditions (prebend 0 m at r/R=0.0, prebend -4 m at r/R=1.0, twist -2 deg at r/R=0.85, twist 14 and 15 deg at r/R=0.0). Many quotes are only axis labels or subplot captions and do not contain the stated values, so quote support is weak throughout. Values read off the curves (e.g. chord 5.2 m at r/R=0.2 where the curve peaks near 5.8 m, chord 1.5 m at r/R=1.0 where the tip drops lower) are approximate in both sets; the figure is a plot, so exact point values are inherently uncertain.
